feature_definitions.vf_baseline_rolling_policy: VF is a v1 electrical passthrough feature only. It is not part of the v1 baseline or rolling signal set. Presence, absence, or all-NaN VF telemetry must not change the v1 feature schema.

feature_designation.module_features_boundary: Module-level aggregates are computed over the complete trajectory. They are retrospective and must not be used as observation-time features for detecting an anomaly at an earlier cycle.

temperature_normalization_configuration.normalization_equation: RDS_on_normalized = RDS_on_measured / (R_type(Tj) / R_type(T_ref)); R_type(Tj) = R_ref + (R_hot - R_ref) * (Tj - T_ref) / (T_hot - T_ref)
temperature_normalization_configuration.source: Declared ModuleProfile typicals at T_ref and T_hot (M4 type curve)
assumptions: Linear temperature dependence of RDS_on between T_ref and T_hot
ModuleProfile typicals at T_ref and T_hot define the type curve
